pagination.description: Standard pagination parameters; results ordered by subscription ID ascending.

dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.QuerySubscript.title: Query Subscriptions All Request
dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.QuerySubscript.description: QuerySubscriptionsAllRequest is the request type for the Query/SubscriptionsAll RPC method.

key.description: key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key should be set.

offset.description: offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable. It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should be set.

limit.description: limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page. If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description: count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs. count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key is set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title: Page Request
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.description: PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient pagination. Ex:  message SomeRequest {          Foo some_parameter = 1;          PageRequest pagination = 2;  }

subscriptions.description: List of all subscriptions in the system, ordered by subscription ID ascending.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata for result set navigation.

dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.QuerySubscript.title: Query Subscriptions All Response
dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.QuerySubscript.description: QuerySubscriptionsAllResponse is the response type for the Query/SubscriptionsAll RPC method.

next_key.description: next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if there are no more results.

total.description: total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total was set, its value is undefined otherwise

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.title: Page Response
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.description: PageResponse is to be embedded in gRPC response messages where the corresponding request message has used PageRequest.  message SomeResponse {          repeated Bar results = 1;          PageResponse page = 2;  }

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description: Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.

cosmos.base.v1beta1.DecCoin.title: Dec Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.DecCoin.description: DecCoin defines a token with a denomination and a decimal amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Dec which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.

creator.description: creator account that owns this subscription

filter.description: GJSON filter to match events across the normalized block event array

args.description: positional args as JSON list string

kwargs.description: keyword args as JSON dict string

task_gas_limit.description: gas limit for the created crontask

task_gas_fee.description: fee for the created crontask; also charged at subscription creation/renewal

status.description: status: enabled|disabled|error - enabled: Active, processing events. - disabled: Recoverable pause (time expired, insufficient funds) - can be re-enabled via RenewSubscription. - error: Unrecoverable (invalid address, task creation failed) - cannot be re-enabled.

trigger_count.description: total number of triggers so far (field name per requirement)

dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.Subscription.title: Subscription
dysonprotocol.crontask.v1.Subscription.description: Subscription defines an event-triggered action to execute a script
